conditions: Nondegenerate Euclidean triangle; C is the included angle between sides a and b.
spoken_aliases: side c squared equals side a squared plus side b squared minus two times side a times side b times cosine of angle c
the square of side c equals the sum of the squares of side a and side b minus twice the product of side a and side b and cosine of angle c

evidence: Choose vectors u and v from the vertex with included angle C, of lengths a and b. The opposite side is the norm of u-v. Squaring gives |u|^2+|v|^2-2u dot v=a^2+b^2-2ab cos(C).

Reference cross-check of the standard relationship: https://openstax.org/books/precalculus-2e/pages/8-key-equations. Checked 2026-11-27. Proposed maintainer approval; not independent human certification.
